output.reason: [ev-6650fd33304c] is a caution saying operators "should" follow the Migrate to TSDB instructions before upgrading from 2.x to 3.0. It does not say what fails, is rejected or stops working if they skip that step, so "must migrate" (migration-required, action-required) claims more than the text supports. The section context also cuts against a strictly mandatory pre-upgrade migration: [ev-8b7267b73a1c] ties the tsdb/v13 requirement to Structured Metadata, and [ev-649f409b4be1] lets operators disable that feature, upgrade, and do the schema migration afterwards. To settle the consequence we need the linked Migrate to TSDB page or other upstream text that says what happens to a 2.x install that upgrades without migrating.
